answer_1.quote: We manually re-evaluate several open-domain QA models on a random subset of NQ-OPEN ... The task of open-domain QA is referred to finding answers for information-seeking questions given a massive knowledge source such as Wikipedia.
answer_1.outputs: Generated answers to factoid information‑seeking questions

answer_2.quote: We adopt three evaluation mechanisms in addition to lexical matching to assess 12 open-domain QA models ... We use Exact‑Match accuracy (EM) and F1 score as automatic metrics.

answer_3.quote: We also test the ability of LLMs for evaluating QA models. ... We call this evaluation method, InstructGPT-eval. We also test GPT-4 (OpenAI, 2023) using the same evaluation method, namely GPT4-eval.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation reflects the true performance of a model ... we ask two human annotators to judge whether a given answer to a question is correct or not.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge the correctness of each answer, allowed to use a search engine for evidence.
